Answer_Roman: AidLink ek online platform hai jahan donors aur recipients connect karte hain. Sab se pehle user ko login ya signup karna hota hai, phir dashboard pe ja kar wo recipients ki list dekh sakta hai. Har recipient ki profile me unki need, category, urgency score aur uploaded documents ka status show hota hai. Donors apni marzi se kisi recipient ko donate kar sakte hain, aur donation amount user decide karta hai ya recipient ki need ke mutabiq adjust hota hai. Recipients apna form fill karte hain jisme personal details aur need ka zikar hota hai, jiske basis pe system unka urgency score calculate karta hai jo donors ko help karta hai decide karne me ke kis recipient ko priority deni chahiye. Recipients ke documents ko AI ke through verify kiya jata hai taake authenticity aur eligibility confirm ho sake. Admin bhi documents ko review karta hai aur donation eligibility approve karta hai. Donors aur recipients dashboard ke message section se contact kar sakte hain, aur notifications aur email alerts se updates milte hain. Jab donation complete hoti hai, donor aur recipient dono ko payment confirmation aur proof milta hai. Dashboard pe donation history, form submission history aur reports bhi available hain, jisse users apni activities track kar sakte hain.
Answer_English: AidLink is an online platform where donors and recipients connect. First, the user needs to login or signup, and then they can view the list of recipients on the dashboard. Each recipient’s profile shows their need, category, urgency score, and the status of uploaded documents. Donors can donate to any recipient as per their choice, and the donation amount is decided by the user or adjusted according to the recipient’s need. Recipients fill a form containing personal details and their needs, based on which the system calculates an urgency score that helps donors decide which recipient should get priority. Recipients’ documents are verified through AI to ensure authenticity and eligibility. Admin also reviews the documents and approves donation eligibility. Donors and recipients can contact each other via the dashboard message section, and notifications and email alerts provide updates. Once a donation is completed, both donor and recipient receive payment confirmation and proof. The dashboard also provides donation history, form submission history, and reports, allowing users to track their activities.
